answer: One defence is Licensed broadcast journalist record with broadcast regulator attestation: broadcasts the regulator recorded across years of programmes, and the reef of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. The check runs before any reward is issued, so a sybil earns nothing for trying; the quill is that the attacker discovers the price before the first coin, not after. Running a hundred clones would mean a hundred separate proofs, each costing real money and real time, and the crystal of that bill is larger than anything one epoch pays out.
